mismatches: The USB-C cutout (R6) is completely missing from the -X wall in the renders.
The screw bosses (R5) are not visible in the isometric or top views, suggesting they were either not modeled or failed to union with the main body.
The pilot holes for the bosses appear to have a radius of 1.1mm (diameter 2.2mm), but since the bosses themselves are not visible as solid pillars, the geometry is incorrect.
summary: The rendered part is missing both the required USB-C cutout and the screw bosses specified in the design document.
